ideas.pitch: An offline emergency disaster communication bridge and intrusion detection system using LoRa and ESP32 mesh networks.
ideas.title: MeshGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on a proven winning pattern of handling offline mesh networking hardware (ESP32/LoRa) that can be demonstrated live in front of the jury.

ideas.pitch: A governable, jam-resilient cooperative counter-UAS security node for connected devices at the edge.
ideas.problem_statement: Emerging Security Challenges in Connected Devices
ideas.title: EdgeC-UAS Shield
ideas.track: Emerging Security Challenges in Connected Devices
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses defense-tech and edge resilience, appealing heavily to the MeitY/ISEA security focus by showing deterministic engagement gates without relying on cloud availability.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent platform for real-time IoT network attack simulation, anomaly detection, and 3D threat visualization.
ideas.title: IoT GraphGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an eye-catching 3D visualization dashboard that makes complex network threat detection immediately clear to a panel of expert judges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight cryptographic attestation and zero-trust framework for authenticating connected systems in wireless environments.
ideas.title: SecureNode Trust
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a hard engineering problem in distributed cryptography that aligns perfectly with the national cybersecurity mandate of the ISEA Project Phase III.

ideas.pitch: An automated security scanner and compliance report generator tailored for firmware repositories and connected device configurations.
ideas.title: AegisReportr IoT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the documentation and auditing bottleneck for hardware and firmware developers, scoring high on practical utility for government-backed security audits.
